shared: Applies wherever this component is used.
label: Option name
stale: Return to this element to finish. If its permissions changed, discard these choices and start again.
failed: Could not save. Your choices are still here.
savedReload: Saved. Reload before making another change.
unknownReload: The permission change could not be confirmed. Copy any choices you want to keep, then reload to check the saved permissions.
keepCurrent: Keep the current value among the allowed choices.
